description: This file defines interfaces for trace iteration and control within the WPEFramework project, including ITraceIterator and ITraceController interfaces.

classes.name: ITraceIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating over trace information, allowing reset and info retrieval.

classes.name: ITraceController
classes.description: Interface for controlling trace settings, enabling or disabling trace categories.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the trace iterator to its initial state.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Retrieves current trace enabled status, module, and category information.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables tracing for a specific module and category.
